thesis: Alphabet je u fiskalnoj 2025. ostvario prihod od 402,8 mlrd USD, što je rast od 15,1% u odnosu na prethodnu godinu, uz neto dobit od 132,2 mlrd USD i neto maržu od 32,8% [1]. Razrijeđena dobit po dionici porasla je s 8,04 USD u 2024. na 10,81 USD u 2025., a omjer duga i kapitala od 0,19 ukazuje na konzervativnu bilansnu strukturu [1]. Dionica trenutno vrijedi 344,24 USD, oko 16% ispod 52-sedmičnog maksimuma od 408,61 USD, uz P/E od 17,27 i forward P/E od 22,84 [1]. Glavni rizici su velika zavisnost prihoda od oglašavanja, intenzivna konkurencija i rastuća ulaganja u nove poslove i tehnologije, koja mogu naštetiti poslovanju i rezultatima [2].

risks.text: We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

Our increasing investment in new businesses, products, services, and technologies is inherently risky, and could divert management attention and harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.

We face intense competition. If we do not continue to innovate and provide products and services that are useful to users, customers, and other partners, we may not remain competitive, which could harm our business, financial condition, and operating results.
